findings.title: vectorElemMinSize panics on nested vector with nil SubType
findings.claim: The top-level guard only skips the bound check when Dimensions == 0; a hand-built nested VectorType with Dimensions > 0 and a nil SubType causes the recursion to call Type() on a nil interface and panic.

findings.title: Undocumented behaviour change for NULL values with negative dimensions
findings.claim: The negative-dimensions check now runs before the data != nil test, so a NULL value with Dimensions < 0 now errors instead of returning nil as before, and this change isn't documented in the PR description.

findings.title: Malformed set/list and vector-parse fallbacks still return nameless TypeCustom
findings.claim: Unlike getCassandraLongType, these two paths still return NewNativeType(protoVer, TypeCustom) without the type name, so resulting errors say 'custom()' instead of naming which type the server sent, inconsistent with the TypeCustom fallback at helpers.go:281 which returns a CustomType.

findings.title: PR body contains 'Generated with Claude Code' attribution line
findings.claim: The PR description ends with a Claude Code attribution line that should be stripped per attribution policy.
